Name: AelaanBluewood's Farmable Pam for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
This one was a request and permissions were open so...yeah. AelaanBluewood's original can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13597]here[/url].

You can buy Pam at Marnie's. She'll live in a barn and drop Beer and sometimes Pale Ale (changed from the original because the idea of "milking" Pam squicked me out too much).

Enjoy?
